reviewNote: General election 7 November 2026: full re-verification of every holder, feed and handle is mandatory after government formation. ministryHandles.note: MFAT's institutional account — distinct from the minister's @NewZealandMFA.

counterparts.name: Rt Hon Winston Peters

xHandles.note: The Foreign Minister's account, displayed as 'Winston Peters'; his own posts are signed -WP. Verified active 3 Aug 2026.
Personal/party-leader account — where the news actually happens. Verified highly active 2026.

counterparts.note: Her direct opposite. Minister feed (bh-peters) is deliberately unfiltered — off-portfolio output included.

socials.evidence: Linked from his official NZ First profile page (nzfirst.nz/winston-peters); verified individual account with 94K followers per profile data, with posts within the past week (early Aug 2026) and constant news citation of his tweets.
Government-verified official Foreign Minister account (bio: posts signed "-WP"); 2,578 posts since Dec 2023 (roughly 2-3 per day) per profile data, with diplomatic posts as recent as late July 2026.

Linked from his official NZ First profile page; profile (10.1K followers) shows multiple posts on most days from late July to 5 Aug 2026, all campaign/party content with a party authorisation statement in the bio. Note: the handle is winstonpetersnzfirst, NOT winstonpetersnz.
Linked from his official NZ First profile page and set as the website on his verified X profile; media coverage of his election-2026 social push cites a June 2026 Facebook post passing 1.7M views.

counterparts.socialsNote: Personal X is his primary voice and the account news cites; the ministerial @NewZealandMFA runs a parallel near-daily diplomatic feed, while party-authorised Facebook and Instagram are in full election-2026 campaign swing. No personal TikTok/YouTube could be verified (party channels only).

counterparts.name: Hon Chris Penk
counterparts.role: Minister of Defence; Minister Responsible for the NZSIS and GCSB
counterparts.note: Her intelligence opposite (all three of Defence, NZSIS and GCSB since 7 Apr 2026). The GCSB and NZSIS beehive term (6837) is new and near-silent; expect his output on bh-penk and bh-defence.

socials.evidence: Profile bio lists his ministerial OIA address (c.penk@ministers.govt.nz) and links his National Party site; 24,689 tweets since 2009 per profile data, with personally-voiced posts observed through 2026 (e.g. Anzac Day with Richard Marles, April 2026).

Linked from his official National Party contact page (national.org.nz/team/chrispenk/contact); page (10K+ likes) carries his recurring "The Latest from Parliament" video updates, though exact recent-post dates could not be read behind the login wall.

Linked from his official National Party contact page; profile shows steady posts 14 July - 3 Aug 2026 on electorate and ministerial topics (shellfish ban, Northland Expressway, building consents), roughly 2-3 per week.

counterparts.socialsNote: Spreads fairly evenly across three personally-voiced channels: a long-running conversational X account, a Facebook page with regular parliamentary video updates, and an active electorate-flavoured Instagram; none is daily, all are weekly-ish. No Truth Social/TikTok presence could be verified; official ministerial presence is beehive.govt.nz/minister/hon-chris-penk.

counterparts.name: Hon Todd McClay
counterparts.role: Minister for Trade and Investment; Associate Minister of Foreign Affairs
counterparts.note: The sole Associate Foreign Minister (per MFAT, re-verified 3 Aug 2026) — deputises for Peters abroad.

socials.evidence: Linked from his official National Party profile (national.org.nz/toddmcclay); posting as recently as 4 July 2026 with regular electorate content (16.6k likes)
Bio carries the parliamentary authorisation statement and links his official site toddmcclay.co.nz, and news orgs cite the account; but the X syndication timeline shows no posts since 14 Jan 2025
Linked from his official National Party profile page and bio matches his current ministerial portfolios; small (~945 followers) with only occasional ministerial-travel reels surfacing

counterparts.socialsNote: Lives on his electorate-focused Facebook page; X was his trade-announcement channel through 2024 but has been dormant since Jan 2025, and Instagram is small and sporadic (beware an older duplicate @toddmcclay IG account that is not the party-linked one).

counterparts.name: Rt Hon Christopher Luxon
counterparts.role: Prime Minister — Minister for National Security and Intelligence

xHandles.note: Verified active 2026. Only intelligence-context posts belong in his timeline — see scope.

counterparts.note: Intelligence hat ONLY. Never bare-name match; never subscribe his general minister term (6794) — the whole PM feed would flood the space. Fed solely by bh-natsec (6715) plus surname+intelligence-context weak rule.

socials.evidence: Newsroom (20 Feb 2026) cites his 250,000-plus-follower Instagram as a busy staff-coordinated channel; bio identifies him as Prime Minister of New Zealand (~256k followers, 2,300+ posts)
Newsroom (20 Feb 2026) reports 192,600 followers and frequent posts (family/PM content) drawing hundreds of replies; PM's office confirmed staff coordinate the accounts
Account carries X government-account verification with PM bio and OIA ministerial email; syndication timeline shows near-daily posts through 3 Aug 2026
PM-branded profile (~177k followers, 3.4M likes) with videos matching his verified official engagements (e.g. Beijing trade visit, policy announcements); 2026 cadence not directly confirmed

counterparts.socialsNote: Runs a genuinely multi-platform, staff-coordinated operation: Instagram and Facebook are his biggest audiences and carry the relatable family/PM content, X is near-daily for announcements and policy, and TikTok is a secondary policy-video channel.

counterparts.name: Hon Mark Mitchell
counterparts.role: Associate Minister for National Security and Intelligence

xHandles.note: Verified real; low posting cadence. His Police/Corrections output must NOT leak in — portfolio-only scope.

counterparts.note: New delegated role from the April 2026 reshuffle. Name-rules only (no feed subscription — his minister feed is mostly Police noise). Common surname: the weak rule requires intelligence context.

socials.evidence: Linked from his national.org.nz bio; page carries 'Authorised by Mark Mitchell MP, Orewa' imprint plus his parliament.govt.nz email, and at 20K followers with a 23 Jul post drawing 1.3K reactions it is clearly his primary, most-engaged channel.
Linked from his national.org.nz bio and carries Instagram's verified badge; own-feed posts on 22 Jul and 2 Jul then roughly weekly through June (5,395 followers) — sporadic recently.

Profile inspected directly: carries 'Authorised by Mark Mitchell, Tamariki House, 7 Tamariki Ave, Orewa' imprint and links his official site markmitchell.national.org.nz; most recent posts 21/20 Apr 2026 then Jan 2026 — event-driven, months apart.
Official Beehive ministerial page with his press-release feed; no personal TikTok, YouTube or Truth Social exists — his party bio links only party-run channels for those.

counterparts.socialsNote: Lives on Facebook — it is his main channel by follower count and engagement; Instagram is an occasional mirror and X is kept for major events and emergencies only.

counterparts.name: Hon Paul Goldsmith
counterparts.note: Domestic-facing portfolio (NZ Pacific communities, not Pacific foreign policy) and Labour has a separate spokesperson (Sepuloni) — registered but off; fed by bh-pacific (6725) when enabled.

Linked from his national.org.nz bio and carries Instagram's verified badge; own posts dated 3 Aug, 29 Jul (x2), 24, 20, 19, 18, 12 and 10 Jul 2026 — every 2-3 days, though to a small 2,333-follower audience.

Official Beehive ministerial biography and release feed across his portfolios; no personal TikTok, YouTube or Truth Social exists — his party bio links only party-run channels.

counterparts.socialsNote: Day-to-day presence is Facebook, with Instagram mirroring it every few days to a much smaller audience; his X account has been abandoned since April 2024 and should not be treated as current.
